reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

title.narrative: MFO Crystal Georgia MSME Loan I

description.narrative: A senior unsecured local currency denominated loan to be provided under Financial Intermediaries Framework ("FIF") in the amount of up to USD 8.0 mln equivalent (EUR 7.6mln) in favour of JSC MFO Crystal. The project is implemented under the Financial Intermediaries Framework with the proceeds designated for on-lending to private micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) in Georgia in accordance with the FIF Policy Statement. The transaction will support the leading microfinance institution in Georgia by (i) diversifying its funding structure through medium-term local currency (LCY) resources and (ii) enhancing the growth of its MSME loan portfolio.
